METHOD-HAAR-TATE-BOUNDARY-VARIATION-2026.title: The semisimple Haar obstruction is a Tate boundary-graph coupling; even that target space is unbounded on actual safe phases

METHOD-HAAR-TATE-BOUNDARY-VARIATION-2026.use: Keep the full complement MHS extension and its original weights. Symmetric weight4 polarization removes a possible rank-one skew logarithm on grW4. Relative-filtration uniqueness then gives M=W and a two-weight drop on eigenvalue1, confining the ACTUAL Haar variation to W_-4 H_2(F), dual to the Tate boundary graph. With semisimple fibre1, zero invariant Tate part is sufficient for eventual-pure all-marker safety, including primitive branches and all recompositions.

METHOD-HAAR-TATE-BOUNDARY-VARIATION-2026.boundary: Both COMPLETE exceptional MZ cases remain OPEN. Semisimple fibre eigenvalue1 is not established universally. The Tate confinement is before purity, but safety still requires eventual purity. The ACTUAL safe one-weight biform family has invariant Tate dimension at least2k/N-1, so universal zero invariant Tate space on the entire pure locus is FALSE. This is distinct from its larger genus-radical bound. No new safety-sector claim, all-ring topological promotion or universal machine verification; review deferred.
